entries.4bdbbe2ed2adf3ba: It says it does not disclose a medium- to long-term plan, and that it publishes its outlook for each fiscal year and explains its management plan for the following fiscal year at its earnings briefings. As its management strategy, it seeks to strengthen relationships with existing customers and develop new trading partners in the renovation and remodeling market and the non-residential market, in addition to its main market of new housing, by leveraging sales with installation and its logistics functions. It also says it is focusing on expanding construction revenue and construction business areas through further enhancement of its construction functions, on expanding sales of environmentally considerate products such as solar power generation systems and storage batteries and original products, and on improving operational efficiency. As priority issues to address, it cites strengthening its sustainability initiatives and realizing management that is conscious of cost of capital.
